name: CP_CaptionAutoEndClose
formula: Caption@hap update (slot 9, 0x140348960): an auto-ending caption ([0x48] != 0) switches ACTIVE -> DONE once [0x141419910] is 0, without closing the letterbox it opened ([0x49]). The script end (slot 12) only closes an ACTIVE caption, so when the auto end comes first the letterbox and the control lock (0x2000 in 0x1410297C0) stay on. Cave: mov rcx, rbx; call the caption close helper (slot 5, 0x1403450D0: if [0x49] close + clear 0x2000 + [0x49] = 0); mov rcx, rbx; then the 8 original bytes; jmp site+8.

name: CP_LetterboxCaptionRelease
instruction: sub dword ptr [rcx + 0x2d78], 1 ; mov eax, dword ptr [rcx + 0x2d78] ; jns 0x1408a059a
formula: Letterbox close request 0x1408A0560, path for closes without the event flag (captions, phase events). Opens come in two kinds: plain ([0x2D78]) and caption holds ([0x2D7C], from 0x140910E80 with a nonzero argument). Captions and phase events open with a hold but close down the plain counter, so a close made while an event holds the letterbox ([0x2D74] >= 1) left its hold behind, and the event end (which keeps the letterbox while [0x2D7C] > 0) then never closed it. Cave: sub [rcx+0x2d78],1; jns plain; if [rcx+0x2d7c] > 0: dec [rcx+0x2d7c]; jmp 0x1408A0590 (the original no-plain-hold path); plain: mov eax,[rcx+0x2d78]; jmp 0x1408A059A.
